high_level_description: The image is a black-and-white photograph taken in the summer of 1896, as indicated by the caption. It features two men standing in front of a large, elegant villa with a Mediterranean architectural style. The villa has multiple stories, balconies, and arched doorways, suggesting it might be a luxurious residence or a place of significance. The man on the left is identified as Alfred Nobel, the Swedish chemist and inventor who founded the Nobel Prizes. He is dressed in a dark coat and trousers, and he appears to be wearing a hat.
